items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I worked there six months with them. Bill and D.D. and Alba Jow.

ctx.x: You were there a long time?

Yeah, that's right. I used to work, uh, you had another place. We worked in Napoleon Avenue in Chapa Tour. Uh, probably by the name of George Heffler had that club out there. And he'd work there regularly. I was with George Williams up there. I worked there. World War II, I'm trying to think. I think I was at the, uh, World War II, uh, I think it was either last round up or at Popeye's on Decatur Street. I worked out there for quite a long time with, uh, Kid Howard out there.
